episodeTitle.en: Marc Andreessen: The real AI boom hasn’t even started yet
episodeTitle.zh: 马克·安德森：真正的AI热潮尚未真正开启

guestBioOfficial.en: Marc Andreessen is a founder, investor, and co-founder of Netscape, as well as co-founder of the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). In this conversation, we dig into why we’re living through a unique and one of the most incredible times in history, and what comes next. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马克·安德森是Netscape的创始人、投资者及联合创始人，也是风投公司安德森·霍洛维茨（a16z）的联合创始人。在本次对话中，我们深入探讨为何我们正生活在历史上最独特、最令人惊叹的时代，以及未来将何去何从。*我们将讨论：*

title.en: Marc Andreessen: The real AI boom hasn’t even started yet
title.zh: 马克·安德森：真正的AI热潮尚未真正开启

summary.en: Marc frames AI as a "philosopher's stone" that turns the world's most abundant resource - sand - into its rarest - thought. He argues AI arrives just in time to offset declining population growth and labor shortages. The episode explores how the most forward-leaning founders are reimagining companies where a single founder does almost everything.
summary.zh: 马克把 AI 比作"哲人石"——把世界上最丰富的资源（沙）转化为最稀有的资源（思想）。他认为 AI 来得正是时候，足以抵消人口下降与劳动力短缺。本期探讨了最前沿的创始人如何重新构想"一个人几乎包揽所有事"的公司。
